meta.title: Language step: English preselected, a tap switches the app at once and Continue stays enabled
precondition: First run (reset link), app language English, guest
steps: Reset (app language English) → Language → check: onboarding.language
Read selected state of the three rows and Continue
Tap Русский, read the screen and Continue
Tap O'zbekcha (uz row), read the screen
expected: onboarding.lang-en is selected, lang-uz and lang-ru are not; onboarding.continue is enabled — UI tree + screenshot
After tapping Русский: lang-ru selected, progress "Шаг 1 из 4" within 2 s, event onboarding_language {locale: ru}, Continue enabled — UI tree + QA events
After tapping uz: lang-uz selected, progress "1-qadam, jami 4", event onboarding_language {locale: uz} — UI tree + QA events

done: First run (reset link), app language English, guest
